title: History 1065: Bug 1917411 - Stop assembling date, time, and interval strings from localised parts. r=aleca This patch removes all (that I could find) attempts to assemble localised strings from their various components (e.g. day + " " + monthName + " " + year) and replaces then with standard methods using Intl.DateTimeFormatter.
